name: Joining The Military
overview: Scripture encourages believers who join the military to trust in God's presence and strength amid daunting challenges, reminding them not to fear overwhelming enemies because the LORD who delivered His people is with them (Deuteronomy 20:1; Joshua 1:9). The Psalms affirm that true salvation and help come from God alone, not from human strength (Psalms 20:6; 108:12), while Isaiah assures that God Himself will strengthen, help, and uphold His servants (Isaiah 41:10). Jesus' teaching on the greatest love—laying down one's life for friends (John 15:13)—calls Christian soldiers to a sacrificial love rooted in faith and courage.
